user.title: Broan Range Hood
user.description:
Connect your Broan/NuTone smart range hood.

You will need:
• Your Broan app email and password
• The **serial number** printed on the label inside your range hood (e.g. `A12345678`).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Broan servers. Check your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: This range hood is already configured.
